description: List connectors, the outside services whose tools join this chat over MCP, such as Notion, GitHub, Stripe, Linear, Figma, Calendly or Zapier. Returns the ones the user added with their status, and the directory of ones they can add, each with `steps` to connect it and a `page_url`. Call it when someone asks about a service list_integrations does not have, or what tools they could add. Pass `query` to narrow by name or purpose. To start connecting one, call add_connector. A service that is in neither list can still be added by its MCP server URL on `custom_server_url`.

query.description: A name or what it is for, e.g. 'notion' or 'payments'.

name: list_connectors
title: Check connectors
